title: evalgate: floorBindingGate discards triage-decision read errors; Gate A may point the agent at a deny-write path
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 12 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) floorBindingGate.check discards the errors from triagecap.ReadDeferredFloors and ReadDeclaredFloors, so a malformed triage-decision.json reads as 'nothing declared' and the gate passes in silence. (2) For an eval that exists but has no [code] grader, Gate A's remediation names whatever path evalFilePath found. That can be the project-root path, which the gate's own reasoning says is deny-write under the sandbox. (3) LintMonotonicBinaryTarget has no production caller; only tests and go/acs/cycle1690 use it. (4) Comments in go/acs/cycle332 and cycle987 cite evalgate line numbers that are now stale.
fix: Treat a read or parse error on triage-decision.json as a gate finding (fail loud), with a test. Make the remediation always name the writable workspace path. Wire LintMonotonicBinaryTarget into its intended gate, or delete it along with its predicate.
acceptance: A malformed triage-decision.json makes the floor-binding gate report an error, not a pass (test)
Gate A's remediation never names a deny-write path (test)
LintMonotonicBinaryTarget has a production caller or is gone
